fact: The project closing report states that e-GP software had not been implemented by project closing, final achievement of the share-of-competitive-biddings-using-e-GP indicator stood at zero, and acquisition of the e-GP system was dropped; only a readiness report, strategy and roadmap, procurement manual and standard bidding documents were delivered.
title: The Gambia Fiscal Management Development Project (P166695) Implementation Completion and Results Report
